notes.title: HOTFIX PATCH NOTES 25 September
notes.content: [p]Hey Operators,[/p][p]Thanks for supporting Arena Breakout: Infinite! We want you to have a fun and enjoyable experience with the game, so we will be making some updates and adjustments to it. The specifics are detailed below.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Time:[/b][/p][p]Sep. 25, 2025 (UTC+0)[/p][p][b]How to Update:[/b][/p][p]Live Update. If you are online during the update, you must exit the game, then click Update in the game's launcher to complete the update. [/p][p][/p][p]Live Update. If you are online during the update, you must exit the game and then update the game in your Steam Library.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Updated Content:[/b][/p][p]Event Updates and Changes[/p][p][b]1. Login Rewards[/b][/p][p][b]Event Time:[/b] Sep. 30 – Oct. 07 (UTC+0)[/p][p]Check in daily to claim a wealth of rewards, including a Weapon Skin Voucher, Pet Voucher, Universal Keycard Chain, Advanced Quick Kit, and Premium Random Koen Bundle![/p][p]2. Twilight Embers Military Supply duration has been extended, with the end date adjusted to October 30, 2025.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][p]1. Added a starting limit for Lockdown Zone: 1,000,000 Koen Coins. If the value of the equipment exceeds the limit, the match cannot be initiated.  [/p][p]2. Increased the scanning range of the Recon Terminal on the TV Station map, from scanning the 1st-floor area to scanning the 1st and 2nd-floor areas.  [/p][p]3. Increased the basic stats of the MDR Integrated Handguard.[/p][p]Vertical Recoil Control: 6 -> 7[/p][p]Horizontal Recoil Control: 7 -> 11[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue with incorrect selling prices for 3 types of cards in the Night City Defender event.[/p][p]5. Fixed the display issue that occurs when returning to the Lobby from the shooting range after equipping the Banishing Blade.[/p][p]6. Fixed the display issue with the Simple Red Dot Sight when the Twilight Embers skin is applied.[/p][p]7. Fixed the issue on the Farm map where characters could get stuck in certain areas of the Stables.[/p][p]8. Fixed the issue where the Highlights feature fails to activate automatically in Covert Ops mode.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue where the scanning sound effects from the Recon Terminal would persist after returning to the Lobby if a player extracted while the scanning screen remained active.[/p][p]10. Fixed the issue where the Show Outfit button on the equipment screen would reset to a deactivated state after logging back into the game.[/p][p]11. Fixed the issue where the quality of items in the Trophy Room's Badge Shelf was not displayed and adjusted the arrangement order  .[/p][p]12. Fixed the issue that prompted players to purchase owned weapons when selecting a preset build.[/p][p]13. Fixed the blurry text in tactical files.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your valuable feedback and suggestions![/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][b]The Arena Breakout: Infinite Team[/b][/p][p][b]Sep. 24, 2025 (UTC+0)[/b][/p]

notes.title: Arena Breakout: Infinite Bans Notice - September 23rd
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]As the security team of Arena Breakout: Infinite, we are highly aware of how important the game's stability and security is to players. That is why we have a 0% tolerance policy for any instances of rule breaking that occurs within the game (including but not limited to using plug-ins or unauthorized apps and intentionally collaborating with a player who's using plug-ins). The instant we become aware of a potential rule violation, we will immediately investigate it and implement a serious penalty if needed(including but not limited to a ten-year ban, your device being banned, and a bulletin about being circulated both in and out of the game).[/p][p][/p][p]Let it be known that Arena Breakout: Infinite has already implemented a real-time banning policy. All suspicious accounts and historical data will be investigated and, if found guilty of a rule violation, either be banned or have their current ban extended. Additionally, we welcome players to make reports themselves if they see anyone breaking the rules. This can be done by using the Report function in the game and on our social media. Let's all work together to create a fair, equal, and enjoyable game experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Compensation this period(September 15 - September 21):[/b][/h3][p][b]Players Compensated:[/b] 7351[/p][p][b]Koen Value:[/b] 6.63 Billion[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Penalties this period(September 15 - September 21):[/b][/h3][p][b]Bans for Cheating:[/b] 3059[/p][p][b]10-Year Bans:[/b] 334[/p][p][b]Device/IP Bans:[/b] 266[/p][p][b]Bans:[/b] 2459[/p][p][b]Bad Behavior:[/b] 56[/p][p][b]Griefing:[/b] 56[/p][p][b]Koen Confiscations:[/b] 339[/p][p][b]Playing with Hackers:[/b] 339[/p][p][b]information blocked:[/b] 64,133[/p][p][/p][p]Please follow our rules of conduct and enjoy the game.[/p][p][b]Arena Breakout: Infinite's Security Team[/b][/p][p][b]September 23, 2025[/b][/p]

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know About Arena Breakout: Infinite
notes.content: [h3][b]Where It All Began – the Closed Beta Breakout[/b][/h3][p]In May 2024, our closed test surprised the shooter looter community. No crosshair, real gear loss on death, tangible risk: that was the first public glimpse of Arena Breakout: Infinite. After more than a year of polish, we can finally announce that Arena Breakout: Infinite arrives on Steam on 15 September. If you have not tried it yet, give us the next few minutes to win you over.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/c3c49cbee9a9176525498757d1c479c2a720e842.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Road to Full Release[/b][/h3][p]We kept listening to our community. One year later, the Steam Full Release lands with no more Koen purchasing option, red-tier ammo removed from market, and the strongest helmets and vests now craft-only. Our anti-cheat system has been updated 4,516 times, resulting in an 81.7% reduction in detected cheaters. HD visuals, smoother controls, larger maps, dynamic weather, and numerous other optimizations make Arena Breakout: Infinite the best it has ever been.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/3131f56331141cea2e1dac558b5bb9039bc55c83.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Than Just Another Shooter[/b][/h3][p]Unlike most shooters, Arena Breakout: Infinite isn't focused on kill counts or battle-royale rankings. You enter a sealed zone with your own gear, search for loot, collect trophies, and extract alive. Winning a fight doesn't guarantee success; only extraction does. Every enemy you encounter is another player risking all their belongings just like you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/009ad3f0da1f85f7282f11c1df906d9dc752e5b7.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Pay-to-Win? Not Any More[/b][/h3][p]As our game continues to evolve, we are refining both its economy and balance. Resource acquisition now relies entirely on gameplay and effort: the gold-purchasing system has been fully closed. Likewise, red-tier ammo and the best armor & helmet will only be obtained through crafting or battlefield encounters, no longer through market trade. Arena Breakout: Infinite aims to ensure that every achievement reflects real strategy and dedication, bringing gear and wealth back to the true challenge and enjoyment of the game. This is a world where victory is defined by judgment and courage, not by shortcuts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/a0da52522b96c87c292c3536df5aa223c113c334.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Realism with Purpose[/b][/h3][p]Players love Arena Breakout: Infinite for the subtle systems that reveal themselves over time.[/p][p]Rain drowns out footsteps. After losing a skirmish, dive into the downpour and slip away while pursuers hear nothing but rain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/e02a5218d93d018a131b2a3bb2a13e9fc55621b2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fog wipes the far horizon. A squad caught in a tightening noose can use the haze to pivot, flank, and escape what looked like a sure wipe.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/a6da0debcd015c143d6e115bf9b2ac1bd6da12bf.gif"][/img][/p][p]Sunlight betrays the careless. At certain hours, a low sun stretches your shadow around corners, casting a shadow on anyone watching the wall.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/cee0053b66c213fe2e4ee38749e3f3b0a3d66496.gif"][/img][/p][p]Sound is pure intel. You can tell if an enemy upstairs is reloading or popping painkillers in the kitchen.[/p][p]Gears such as Life sensors, grenades, and masks are built for results, not flash. Plan ahead, fire only when it matters, and walk out rich.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Five Distinct Maps[/b][/h3][p]If you're new to the Dark Zone, Farm is the ideal place to start.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/3f6caccfe4aee3892c7ae399928a5214f0db31bb.gif"][/img][/p][p]It has decent loot, a tight layout, and short extraction routes, making it perfect for learning through action. Many knife runners also return here for quick comeback chances. With new areas added in Season 2, this beginner-friendly map now offers more room for tactical plays.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/429138ee32161531a25d01307f7e7c7e455c6aee.gif"][/img][/p][p]TV Station is a very different experience.[/p][p]Designed for players who enjoy intense close-quarters combat, this small indoor map is packed with staircases, corners, and tight spaces. It has the highest fight frequency and is best suited for those who love fast, high-pressure gunfights.Besides these two popular maps, there are three more with distinct styles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/585453f021c2b3cca3982128601f921853c9360e.gif"][/img][/p][p]Armory features enclosed combat zones with dense loot, better for coordinated squads.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/f850f881fc982c2c4751ca7185d6c546a2856f61.gif"][/img][/p][p]Valley and Northridge offer long sightlines, high ground, and forested cover. Perfect for ambushes, sniping, or staying off the radar.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2c1af39b613f5774fb2aa1b8407e4e136f8e4f94.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Start Safe, Then Risk Big[/b][/h3][p]Visit the Shooting Range first. Test every weapon and explore the Gunsmith. Build from the bolt carrier up; barrels affect damage and effective range, ergonomics affect stamina cost while aiming, and recoil is only the beginning. When you have a favourite setup, try Secure Ops first. In this mode, a failed run does not cost gear loss, making it perfect for learning routes, loot spots, and hiding places. Soon you will realise that timing, audio cues, and custom weapons matter more than raw aim.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0930469fcdfd5b40bb36c9ccbbc253f0f5e3f8cf.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Choose Your Approach[/b][/h3][p]Inside a raid, you choose how to roll.[/p][p]Some operators go lone wolf, grab loot with a shotgun, and sprint for the exit. Others run tight four-person teams, sweeping every corner for targets and treasure.[/p][p]Standard in-game voice keeps your fireteam synced, and next season's new Squad Channel will let smaller groups talk freely without the rest of the team hearing.[/p][p]Whether you're a Rookie or Vet, you are welcome to hop into our Discord "Vets Help Rookies" program next season. Packed supply drops and guidance will help everyone hit the ground running.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/e2f8742a8b3541670157628fd932d75a1c3d4ff0.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Than Just Combat[/b][/h3][p]Between raids, you manage your Trophy Room, craft equipment, boost fitness, and display collectibles. After every run, you sort loot, repair armor, and repack magazines. To make money, you can run low-risk materials loot and sell them for high. To chase high-end gear, you invest resources and accept risks. The more you understand, the deeper the loop pulls you in.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0fc7d86a46708cdd30c69e27d896bd8d88a3df14.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Why Play Now[/b][/h3][p]ABI has steadily grown into the game it is today, shaped by richer content and constant community-driven improvements. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0e877c81911e08138df1d41385f08cb6ecdc911c.png"][/img][/p][p]Its evolution is built not on marketing spend, but on consistent updates and feedback that make each battle more engaging and rewarding. If you want a shooter where survival depends on skill, quick reads, and solid prep, this build is the one to try. Casual operators can still profit by smart routing and keen ears, steering clear of gunfights and scooping up valuables; treasures in Kamona are scattered far beyond the obvious hotspots. The game is free to download, sells no stat boosts, and lets you set your own pace—charge in or play it safe as you please. Starting with the Steam Full Release, every operator can unlock the largest 3 × 3 Secure Case for free by completing seasonal tasks, giving you extra space to haul your winnings home.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for today, and don't forgot to follow our official channels for first-hand updates, dev insights, and community events. See you soon in Kamona.[/p][p] [/p]

Everyone earns something here. Suitable for new operators in the Dark Zone.[/p][h3][b]Lockdown Zone[/b][/h3][p]A dangerous Lockdown Zone rich in supplies. A ticket is required to enter, and you must also bring equipment totaling up to a certain value.[/p][p]Suitable for experienced operators.[/p][h3][b]Forbidden Zone[/b][/h3][p]A lethal Forbidden Zone replete with supplies. A more expensive ticket is required to enter, and you must also bring even pricier equipment.[/p][p]Suitable only for the strongest operators.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]Covert Ops[/b][/h3][p]Enter the Dark Zone with random equipment. Play as a militant and search for remaining supplies on the battlefield without using any equipment from your Storage.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Solo Op[/b][/h3][p]Enter the raid solo with the same equipment value and Koen cost as the conventional Lockdown Zone mode. Solo Op supports Rank Points.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Secure Ops[/b][/h3][p]In Secure Ops, you won't lose any gear when you fail to extract. If you extract successfully, all the supplies you've gotten in the raid will be converted into Koen.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Team Elimination[/b][/h3][p]No need to bring in any gear, select your set when the raid begins. Engage in round-based faction combat. The first faction to win 4 rounds wins.[/p][h3] [/h3][h3][b]Team Deathmatch[/b][/h3][p]You will be divided into two factions for the battle. Eliminated players will respawn immediately. The first team to reach the specified number of eliminations wins.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Arsenal Shuffle[/b][/h3][p]When you are eliminated, your weapon will be replaced with a random one. The first faction to reach the required number of eliminations in the allotted time wins.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Arsenal[/b][/h3][p]In Arsenal mode, each level corresponds to a different weapon. Your level increases by 1 for every 2 enemies eliminated, and your weapon will be replaced with a weapon that matches your new level. The first team to eliminate 1 enemy with a max level weapon is the winner.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Available Weapon Types[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2539f0107a6d48f59d69ab825f1d5d8ab56803a9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Assault Rifles[/b][/h3][p]AK-74N, AKS-74U, AK-102, F2000, H416, MDR, M4A1, SCAR-L, AR-57, T951, T03, ACE31, AEK, AKM, FAL, AK-12, MCX, AUG, PCC-9, G3, SG550, ZC807, and AN-94.[/p][h3][b]Carbines[/b][/h3][p]M16, Mini14, M96, SA85M, SKS, BM59, M14, and SVTU.[/p][h3][b]Micro SMGs[/b][/h3][p]UMP45, MAC-10, M3A1, MPF45, Vector 45, MP5, MPX, Uzi, MP40, Vector 9, P90, QC61, T85, T79, and PP19-01.[/p][h3][b]Marksman Rifles[/b][/h3][p]M110, SVDS, VSS, Mk14, and ML Lever-Action Rifle.[/p][h3][b]Sniper Rifles[/b][/h3][p]M24, Mosin, and SJ16.[/p][h3][b]Shotguns[/b][/h3][p]MP-133, M870, USAS-12, S12K, and SPR310.[/p][h3][b]Machine Guns[/b][/h3][p]RPK-16.[/p][h3][b]Pistols[/b][/h3][p]Desert Eagle, Gold Desert Eagle, M1911, T54, CZ 52, M9A3, G18C, MP9, T05, G17, M45A1, and F57.[/p][h2][/h2][h2][b]Season 3 Mission:[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/a4f061e91a9f5763a341de9d272e58a913774934.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The intervention of the Sumek Committee forced a ceasefire in the North-South Conflict, which ultimately resulted in the creation of the Dark Zone. Please keep an eye on future announcements or the in-game Event Calendar to learn more about upcoming events.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]FAQ[/b][/h2][p][b]Q: Why am I unable to download the game?[/b][/p][p]A: Please ensure your device meets the minimum requirements listed above and has 70 GB of available storage space. We are continuously improving the game's performance and minimum requirements, and we sincerely apologize if you encounter this issue.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How can I optimize the game's performance on my laptop?[/b][/p][p]A: You can change your laptop's GPU direct mode (see your laptop manufacturer's website for details) or play with your battery plugged in to improve performance.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What should I do if I encounter bugs or issues while playing?[/b][/p][p]A: You can contact customer service via the methods listed below:[/p][p]- In-Game: Submit your feedback via Settings -> Privacy -> Customer Service.[/p][p][/p][p]- Official Website: Reach out to our customer service via Support -> Contact Us on our official website [url="https://(https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com/en)"](https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com/en)[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, you can join our Discord community and submit your feedback to an official moderator.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Can I use my official account on Steam?[/b][/p][p]A: A Level Infinite Pass account is required to log in to Arena Breakout: Infinite, so your account information can be used on multiple platforms and will be synced between them. Your account is not limited by platform.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Is matchmaking available between players using Steam and official accounts?[/b][/p][p]A: Players from all platforms can join matchmaking and play together in Arena Breakout: Infinite.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: I've already downloaded Arena Breakout: Infinite. Do I need to download the game again to play it via Steam?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes, redownloading is required if you intend to launch the game via Steam.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Are controllers supported?[/b][/p][p]A: Controllers are currently not supported.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Does Arena Breakout: Infinite support Linux or the Steam Deck?[/b][/p][p]A: Linux and the Steam Deck are currently not supported.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Can I choose which server to play on?[/b][/p][p]A: In the current version, you cannot select a specific server. The system will automatically assign players to the optimal server based on their IP address to ensure the lowest possible network latency.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Which season is the game currently in? Will there be a wipe?[/b][/p][p]A: The full release version marks our Season 3 BREACH. Currently, there are no plans for a wipe.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Which languages are supported?[/b][/p][p]A: The game supports multiple languages, including English, Chinese, German, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish, and Thai. Support for additional languages will be added in future updates.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What is Elite Privilege?[/b][/p][p]A: Elite Privilege is a membership system in the game that provides additional benefits, such as increased storage space, exclusive skins, and other in-game rewards. This privilege can typically be unlocked by purchasing a membership or completing specific tasks.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How do I launch and log into the game on the Steam version?[/b][/p][p]A: You need to launch the game through Steam and log in using your Level Infinite Pass account.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How do I link my game account to Steam?[/b][/p][p]A: After launching the game, log in to your existing LIP account via the Launcher.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Will my playtime and achievements as an existing player be synced with Steam?[/b][/p][p]A: No, Steam achievements are not available at this time.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What anti-cheat system does ABI use?[/b][/p][p]A: The game uses ACE (Anti-Cheat Engine) as its anti-cheat monitoring system. ACE is our core system for detecting, analyzing, and banning cheating activities, ensuring a fair and competitive environment for all players. For more information, please visit: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2073620/view/743778724199006279"]Arena Breakout: Infinite - Introducing ACE: The Anti-Cheat System Behind Arena Breakout: Infinite - Steam News[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How do I report cheaters?[/b][/p][p]A: If you encounter players engaging in malicious behavior such as teamkilling, you can report them through the following methods:[/p][p]After a match, click the \[Report] button on the match results screen.[/p][p]Within 24 hours after a match, go to \[Personal Info] - \[Match History] on the top right of the main interface, and select \[Using Cheating Tools] to report.[/p][p]Once a report is submitted, the system will review the reported player. If violations are confirmed, appropriate penalties will be applied.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How do I report inappropriate nicknames or profile pictures?[/b][/p][p]A: If you encounter players with \[inappropriate profile pictures], you can report them through the following methods:[/p][p]After a match, click the \[Report] button on the match results screen.[/p][p]Go to \[Personal Info] - \[Match History] on the top right of the main interface, and select \[Posting Inappropriate Content] to report.[/p][p]Click on the reported player’s \[Profile] - \[Report Player] to submit a report.[/p][p]Once a report is submitted, the system will review the reported player. If violations are confirmed, appropriate penalties will be applied.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in Kamona![/p][p] [/p][p][b]The Arena Breakout: Infinite Team[/b][/p][p][b]Sep. 16, 2025 (UTC+0)[/b][/p]

notes.title: Introducing ACE: The Anti-Cheat System Behind Arena Breakout: Infinite
notes.content:
[p]Ensuring a fair and secure gaming environment is one of our core commitments to all Arena Breakout: Infinite players. That commitment is supported by a robust [b]anti-cheat system: ACE (Anti-Cheat Expert).[/b][/p][p][b]Here's a quick FAQ to help you better understand ACE and how it works in Arena Breakout: Infinite.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]FAQ[/h2][h3][b]Q: Why does Arena Breakout: Infinite use ACE?[/b][/h3][p]Arena Breakout: Infinite is an immersive tactical extraction shooter where every raid is a fight to survive, or lose it all. That's why fairness matters in every encounter.[/p][p]We chose [b]ACE[/b] because it's a proven anti-cheat solution that has been successfully deployed in other titles, offering powerful detection and enforcement capabilities.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past year of Early Access, [b]ACE[/b] has demonstrated reliable performance and earned the trust of many players. Since the start of EA, we've rolled out [b]4,516[/b] anti-cheat updates, successfully detected and blocked [b]293[/b] cheat tools, and banned [b]408,133[/b] cheating accounts, significantly reducing in-game cheating behavior and helping us maintain a fair environment.[/p][p]This is why we're confident in continuing with [b]ACE[/b] for the full release.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: Why is ACE a kernel-level anti-cheat?[/b][/h3][p]Like many industry-standard solutions, [b]ACE[/b] runs at the kernel level to detect and block advanced cheats that operate at the same system layer. This includes common high-level threats such as VT-based evasion and DMA attacks.[/p][p][b]ACE[/b] does not read or retain any data unrelated to the game's anti-cheat functionality. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: Will [/b]ACE [b]be installed automatically? Is it removed when I uninstall Arena Breakout: Infinite?[/b][/h3][p]Yes. [b]ACE[/b] is automatically installed alongside the game to help protect your environment. When you uninstall Arena Breakout: Infinite, ACE is also fully removed, leaving no residual files or background processes.[/p][p]FYI: If your device has other games installed that also use [b]ACE[/b], the system will remain only to support those games.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: Can ACE conflict with other kernel-level anti-cheat software?[/b][/h3][p]Yes. Kernel-level anti-cheat solutions like EAC or Vanguard may detect each other as potential conflicts, since they cannot mutually verify access.[/p][p]To avoid interference:[/p][p]- When playing Arena Breakout: Infinite, we recommend closing any other anti-cheat software.[/p][p]- When playing other games, you may want to close [b]ACE[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: Does ACE collect my personal data? Should I be concerned about privacy?[/b][/h3][p][b]ACE[/b] only collects data strictly necessary to carry out its anti-cheat functions within Arena Breakout: Infinite. All data is encrypted during handling and transmission, and no personal files, messages, or unrelated information are accessed.[/p][p]All data processing is conducted through data centers located in Singapore, and complies with relevant legal and auditing standards.[/p][p]To learn more, please refer to:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Privacy Policy[/b]
[url="https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com/privacypolicy.html"]https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com/privacypolicy.html[/url][/p][p]
[b]End User License Agreement[/b]
[url="https://eulaforgames.com/rule/202406060003/ALL"]https://eulaforgames.com/rule/202406060003/ALL[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Final Note[/b][/p][p]Fairness is a shared goal, and we're grateful for your support in building a cleaner battlefield.[/p][p]If you have more questions, feel free to reach out in the community.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Arena Breakout: Infinite Team[/b][/p][p][b]September 13, 2025[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Steam Full Release Dev Blog
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone! Arena Breakout: Infinite will officially launch its Full Release on September 15, alongside our long-awaited arrival on Steam.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We're very grateful to everyone who voiced your support and shared your feedback with us. We also want to welcome the new mercenaries who will soon join us through Steam.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/fdd6ee7dc988e78ac3701a2064b5693147e46107.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Authentic Tactical Extraction FPS[/b][/h2][p]Arena Breakout: Infinite is a[b] FREE immersive tactical extraction FPS.[/b] From the Closed Beta in May 2024, to Early Access in August, and now to the upcoming Full Release, every step has been shaped by one core philosophy: [b]authentic gunplay, distinct visual identity, intense combat immersion, and a fair competitive experience.[/b][/p][p]Every fix and update we’ve made has been built around this foundation.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/dc0d6064d1c6b93cf85960265745bf3f847b939d.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Continuous Content Updates: In-Raid and Beyond[/b][/h2][p]Arena Breakout: Infinite's full release comes with 5 maps that vary in size, theme, and environment; and in-raid mechanics such as a dynamic weather system, random extraction points, and supply stations. Every raid will be a brand-new experience![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/aacc3ed2bdf058d4b1dbbc6544eca23c94e3f7eb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/ae5734b0c70dd7776b70d5de0b5014776955e7c6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0b6dd0c07c995f728357729cdc317d6d7f6810f0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/ee2aac1372888398d00df787b0c76bb051f515c2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/57410910179a44d0f796a59d40498b1ea5f7ad9e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/f40ee57ddaae7142fb2ab34f4e5b60571cddb4ac.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][p]We want to break players out of repetitive routines and reduce overreliance on fixed routes and loadouts.We're also striving to keep improving existing maps. For example, the Farm's expansion and the increased amount of cover in maps to provide more tactical choices and tools for collecting information.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/71f3e4feff29e14c13dff81bf4a7c8d1a2ba1ce7.png"][/img][/p][p]Arena Breakout: Infinite offers [b]modes[/b] for every type of player. If you're searching for intense and thrilling raids, Lockdown Zone and Forbidden Zone are the modes for you. If playing solo is your thing, SOLO OP is perfect. As for new recruits in Kamona or players who seek a relaxed experience, you can choose from multiple modes such as Secure Ops, Team Deathmatch, and Team Elimination.[/p][p]In short, Kamona always has a survival way for you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/54ade71f2dcbf9f7fab10205c9674a7f1dfd94d7.png"][/img][/p][p]In the Full Release, the Trophy Room has been fully expanded. Beyond displaying your collection, it now features functional modules that let you strengthen yourself outside of raids and make better use of the miscellaneous items in your Storage.[/p][p] [/p][p]Balance issues related to growth outside of raids are another area we're constantly monitoring, so you'll still get to enjoy fair competition against long-time players. The Trophy Room will continue to receive new content and iterations in future updates, and we encourage you to share your feedback with us![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/6061ef3550157b3239e5a5fa9ace64346c777ddf.png"][/img][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/61de7d86d57da72e696ac69928f8a0084c634beb.png"][/img][/carousel][h2][b]QoL Updates, Smoother and More Enjoyable Experience[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]There are also some quality of life updates that will improve your experience of the game. Many of them come from players in our community. From lobby auto-heal and auto-storage for valuable loot, to kill cam, real-time item value display, and loot priority function—these QoL upgrades are here to make every raid smoother and smarter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2dc00c9c6ae47c89d05d02dda9f116e721dd25d5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the Full Release, we’ve made several improvements to matchmaking efficiency and UI. More quality-of-life changes have been implemented, like you'll be able to link keychains to maps, so once you enter a given map, your keychain will switch automatically. The ability to cancel lockpicking actions; and many other updates, including a new memory feature for Storage organization, squad communication channels, spectating/death replay systems, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Commitment to Fair Play[/b][/h2][p]Since the launch of Early Access, the [b]purchasing Koen system[/b] has served as a part of the in-game economy, designed to support a specific stage of the game’s development. As the game evolved across multiple versions, we saw Operators gaining access to more diverse and rewarding ways to earn Koen. In its early phase, the purchasing Koen system offered some players a fast track to restart and recover — a purpose it has now fulfilled. Therefore, with the Full Release, [b]we have decided to officially bring it to an end, shifting our focus entirely toward more diverse, fair, and rewarding ways for players to earn resources.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Red ammo and high-level armor[/b] are a recurring subject of discussion in our communities, and we have been following it since the beginning. In past updates, we've tried adjusting and balancing their stats in an attempt to resolve the issues. However, the data showed that some items still remained overly dominant. So we decided to place stricter limits on the production of these OP items. Some high-level items will no longer be available to trade in the Market—you'll only be able to get them by crafting them at the Workbench of Trophy Room.[/p][p][/p][p]We've consistently implemented multiple [b]balance adjustments[/b] in the previous seasons. For example, we've implemented an array of restrictive measures to balance the advantages inherent in some equipment and tools that exceeded our expectations, such as the T7 Thermal Imager, throwables that do damage. These adjustments give players more diverse choices, ensuring that every combination of weapons, gear, and tactics can play a meaningful role in each raid. Our attention will remain on balance issues throughout future updates to ensure raids remain fair.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/bdb69571f43272797a43f067304da02a5c5066d4.png"][/img][/p][p]In terms of [b]anti-cheating[/b], we maintain a zero tolerance policy toward all cheating, and we are constantly improving our detection system and will impose strict bans on all cheaters. For players who fall victim to cheaters, we not only compensate the value of lost gear in in-game currency, but also provide an additional “comfort payout.” Our efforts are aimed at maintaining a positive and fair in-game environment for our community.[/p][p] [/p][p]That’s all for this Dev Blog. The Full Release is almost here, and we’ll see you in Kamona! If you want to get game updates and official guides from us, don't forget to follow us on social media![/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073620"][/dynamiclink][/p]

All free, all waiting for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/e1a4898d7a9fea0ecacf2cf00a3030c7327da737.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Take Action Now[/b][/h2][h3][b]Add the Game to Your Wishlist[/b][/h3][p]Secure your spot. Downloads will open on September 15th.[/p][h3][b]Join the Official Socials[/b][/h3][p]Find teammates or mentors and plan your extraction route for Day One.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our arrival on Steam marks a new chapter.[/p][p]The journey continues, with more updates and surprises ahead.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you to every Closed Beta pioneer, every bug hunter, and every veteran who waited patiently.[/p][p][b]Let your extractions become your badge of honor![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Arena Breakout: Infinite Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/871cb5d9d61409f43eac269326ea3ab1efbc3ef4.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]FAQ[/b][/h2][p][b]Q: [/b]How can I link my game account to Steam?[/p][p][b]A: [/b]After launching the game, log in with the same Level Infinite Pass you previously used for the launcher.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Will my previous playtime and achievements sync on Steam?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] No, Steam achievements are currently not supported.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Is cross-progression available across platforms?[/p][p][b]A: [/b]Yes, players will be available to play across Steam, Epic, and Official website build, as long as you log in with the same Level Infinite Pass account, all your game data will stay in sync.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q:[/b] Do I need to download Steam version while I already have Official website build?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] Yes, you will need to download the Steam version if you want to play on Steam platform.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Does the game support Linux or Steam Deck?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] No, not at this time.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Does the game support controllers?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] Not supported for now[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Q: [/b]How can I provide feedback or report issues?[/p][p][b]A: [/b]We take community feedback seriously. notes.title: From Beta to Future, Arena Breakout: Infinite Community Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The round of test for "Arena Breakout: Infinite" has now concluded, and the servers have officially shut down. As this was an exclusive beta trial, all associated game data is scheduled for deletion within the coming 30 business days. 

Ever since we released the first official announcement on STEAM, our game has garnered over 1 million on our Wishlist. We're very thankful to our vibrant community for your constant support and the suggestions that have helped us fine-tune and elevate our game. Your enthusiasm and input are the driving forces behind our continuous improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2b31b72ea1710b5553af360a4b843cb3d063c781.jpg[/img]

Seizing this moment, we would like to share our upcoming plans and address the concerns that are frequently on the minds of our players. 

[b]Q1: Further Update Plans and Launch Milestones [/b]

We've been thrilled by the enthusiastic response and the flood of questions from our players. Your energy and support are greatly appreciated. Our team is fully dedicated to refining the game based on feedback from our test and is actively expanding the game with fresh experiences, including the introduction of new weapons, new maps, and continuous improvement of the QOL systems.
We're working hard to ensure that these updates are released for your enjoyment at the earliest opportunity. For further information, please visit our official social channels and stay connected for updates you won't want to miss!

[b]Q2: About Game Fairness and Subsequent Anti-Cheat Measures[/b]

ABI maintains a strict stance against any breaches of in-game rules and activities that compromise the game's integrity. To date, we have established a robust anti-cheat framework encompassing these four key strategies:

1.	Enhanced endpoint protection: Encrypted user-end code/data to increase the level of protection against hacking, debugging, and tampering.
2.	Cheating tool sample detection: ACE collects cheating tool samples, tests and analyzes them, identifies their characteristics, and enforces block penalties.
3.	Replay automated analysis and manual review: ACE analyzes replay data, restores in-game scenes and operation, uses deep learning models for intelligent analysis, identifies suspicious cheating users for manual review, detects cheating users, and enforces bans.
4.	DMA unauthorized equipment specialized testing: ACE collects DMA-related device information, tests and analyzes device characteristics, builds an unauthorized device library, evaluates user gaming behavior and replay data, identifies cheating users, and applies block penalties.

In the upcoming versions, we will continue to refine our plans and add new features to enhance the experience and improve the gaming environment:

1.	New feature: Kill-Cam.
2.	ACE's memory encryption solution will protect game memory data from DMA cheating tools.
3.	Machine blocking function for blocking malicious users' equipment.

[b]Q3: About Monetization Systems[/b]

There has been quite a bit of discussion among the community about whether "ABI's business model will be Pay-to-Win (P2W)".
ABI operates on a Free-to-Play (F2P) model, aiming to keep the doors wide open for all players. Our in-game purchases focus on offering convenience and personalized customization, steering clear of a Pay-to-Win approach. Whether you pay for it or not, being part of our player base is a big nod of approval to us, and we're truly grateful for it.


In ABI, the balance of combat, the sharpness of your wits, and the importance of your operations truly matter, and these cannot be bought or influenced by payment. Koens, Weapon, Gear, Medical supplies, and other combat essentials are not restricted to those who pay—you can obtain them by trading, looting, taking down enemies, and completing missions.

ABI represents the first PC product from Morefun Studios in many years, after over three years in development. We are expecting great things with this game and are fully committed to it—listening to your feedback, considering every detail, implementing changes, and growing with each step. Your voice matters to us, and we are eternally grateful to all who have joined us in playing our game and being part of our community.

See you in the Dark Zone soon,
Arena Breakout: Infinite Team
